entries.task: Find planted bugs: 105 across two repositories, count fixed
entries.samples: 3 runs per effort, non-superseded rows; each run covers both repositories
entries.metric: planted bugs fixed, mean of 3, out of 105
entries.timeDefinition: wall clock summed over both repositories; the board says these runs shared the machine with other work
entries.costDefinition: list-rate API price estimated from usage counts, summed over both repositories; not an invoice or subscription billing
entries.limitations: Counts planted bugs, not review quality on real changes; repeated attempts are not independent replications; runs used a 1M context window, and the board says its older Opus 5 rows are not comparable to these; the board also lists low and max rungs that this entry leaves out
entries.rationale: Medium used about 30% less cost and 29% less time than high for 1.4 fewer bugs; xhigh found more bugs at much higher cost and time. Medium supports a balanced starting point, not equivalence

entries.task: Find planted bugs: 105 across two repositories, count fixed
entries.samples: 3 runs per effort, non-superseded rows; each run covers both repositories
entries.metric: planted bugs fixed, mean of 3, out of 105
entries.timeDefinition: wall clock summed over both repositories; the board says the machine was idle for these runs, so the times do not compare with the Opus entry's
entries.costDefinition: list-rate API price estimated from usage counts, summed over both repositories; the board notes its harness priced this model on another model's table, so the dollar figure is less certain than the usage counts
entries.limitations: Same board limits as the Opus entry; its older Sonnet 5 rows are not comparable to these; the board also lists low, medium and max rungs that this entry leaves out
entries.rationale: At high and xhigh it found 34.3 and 36.0 planted bugs against Opus's 31.7 and 36.0, at similar cost ($19.85 and $42.86 against $22.25 and $34.98); the times are not comparable. Suggest it only where the user allows that model and effort
